[size=2]Have you ever looked at your wallet items and wondered, what do these do? Look no further![/size]

[size=2]Picture above includes only the key to prevent spoilers but all of them are animated and full of information! [/size]
[size=2]Click the spoiler below to see full animations...[/size]

[size=2]This mod animates and adds helpful descriptions to the wallet items.[/size]
[size=2]Fully Configurable with a verbose description or a basic one, animations on or off.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=3]Default settings inside config.json[/size][/color][/u]
[size=2]  "WalletInfoVerbose": "[/size][color=#00ff00]true[/color][size=2]", ﻿ ﻿<--- change to false if you want the less verbose descriptions[/size]
[size=2]  "WalletItemsAnimated": "[/size][color=#00ff00]true[/color][size=2]", ﻿ ﻿<--- change to false if you do not want the wallet items to be animated[/size]
[size=2]  "VanillaDescriptions": "[/size][color=#ff0000]false[/color][size=2]" ﻿ ﻿<--- change to true if you want the descriptions to go away and have just the name of the item like in vanilla [/size]


[color=#f1c232][size=3][b][u]Example of descriptions:[/u][/b][/size][/color][size=2]
[u][color=#f1c232]Basic [/color][/u]
[color=#6d9eeb]("WalletInfoVerbose": "false" in the config)[/color]
[/size] [size=2]
﻿Rusty Key
﻿
﻿A big old rusty key that might be able to open
﻿a creepy sewer door...


[u][color=#f1c232]Verbose [/color][/u]
[/size][size=2][color=#6d9eeb]("WalletInfoVerbose": "true" in the config)[/color]

﻿Rusty Key

﻿﻿Unlocks the gate at the southern edge of
﻿Cindersap Forest allowing you to access
﻿The Sewers. [/size]

[u][b][size=3]All static wallet items are replaced with animated versions!
[/size][/b][/u][color=#6d9eeb](Click the spoiler below to view them)[/color]
[/font][size=2][font=Arial][spoiler][/font][font=Arial]

Using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], a portion of "Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb" and "Content\Maps\springobjects.xnb" are replaced with our ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/users/75703183]PaulDunstan[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6056146]Myself[/url]) edited versions.
[/size][/font][size=2][font=Arial]

[/font][/size]

[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img][/size][/color][/b]
[/u][font=Arial][size=2]Admittedly I have not yet tried it with a mod loader because I typically do things manually but it should work fine.

[color=#f1c232][b]1)[/b] [/color]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.
[color=#f1c232]
[b]2)[/b][/color] Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]5)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains the assets folder as well as, content.json, & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Wallet Items - Animated and Described\assets"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]7)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size][font=Arial][size=2]
[/size][/font][/font]



[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776467-497634449.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/u]
[font=Arial][size=2][size=2]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.4, 1.5.5 and 1.5.6 [/size]CONFIRMED[size=2]. Probably works with earlier versions as well but I haven't tested it with anything less than 1.5.4.[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Windows and macOS (I have not tested it on Linux but I don't see why it wouldn't work there too)[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Single-player and Multiplayer.[/size]
